audience: Plant manager, production planner, sales, procurement, quality and finance
governing_question: 販売計画と確定受注、品目別製造実績・在庫・限界利益・共通部品制約を踏まえ、翌月の生産と供給をどう優先すべきか
current_answer: 工場全体の生産達成率は高いが需要と品目構成が合っていない。CXの製造を抑え、AX/DXの供給優先度を高め、共通IC-7の追加確保を条件付きで判断する。同時にBX×東亜の赤字取引条件を見直す。

evidence.summary: Oct sales plan 169.01, actual 145.31, backlog AX/DX 195; Nov sales forecast 151.21
Oct good output planned 3720, actual 3790; mix favoring BX/CX over AX/DX
Finished goods book value 33.15 to 44.67; CX closing 600 units and 28.20 mJPY
Customer-SKU contribution totals 33.18; BX-Toua 800 units with -1.60 mJPY
AX needs 2 IC-7 and DX needs 3 IC-7; 3540 net units for November
IC-7 usable 3000 after reserve; estimated 540 expedited quote has no delivery confirmation

claims.text: 工場全体の生産数量は計画超過だが、売上は計画未達
CXは販売計画下振れと生産継続により完成品在庫が増えた
claims.qualification: CX forecast misses and production vs shipments confirm FG accumulation; root cause of forecasting error not determined

claims.text: AX/DXの生産計画未達と確定受注未出荷が併存している
claims.qualification: FG remains on the books, so the reason for unshipped orders is not settled

claims.text: BX×東亜は売上を計上したが変動費基準で採算がマイナス
11月のA/D生産を満たすにはIC-7が540個不足する条件付き試算
claims.qualification: Forecast and available FG, non-IC constraints assumed

claims.text: 追加調達は契約・品質・能力条件を確認後に限定実行する

questions.text: 販売計画と確定受注、品目別製造実績・在庫・限界利益・共通部品制約を踏まえ、翌月の生産と供給をどう優先すべきか
questions.answer: 工場全体の生産達成率は高いが需要と品目構成が合っていない。CXの製造を抑え、AX/DXの供給優先度を高め、共通IC-7の追加確保を条件付きで判断する。同時にBX×東亜の赤字取引条件を見直す。
questions.limitation: Supplier confirmation, quality, customer allocations and line capacities are not provided

hypotheses.text: Demand/product-mix mismatch is the main explanation for production and sales performance divergence
hypotheses.falsifier: If firm order/FG allocation data show no overproduction and no true mismatch, revise the cause

hypotheses.text: Shipment timing or inventory holds, not output volume alone, caused AX/DX overdue orders
hypotheses.falsifier: If all overdue units were truly unavailable by month end and output was sole constraint, reject the timing/hold hypothesis

decision.question: 11月の共通ICと製造能力をどの顧客・品目に配分し、赤字取引と滞留在庫をどう扱うか
decision.working_assessment: Conditionally expedite IC-7; prioritize AX/DX based on customer commitments and contribution; pause CX until FG demand/availability verified; address negative-margin BX-Toua.

options.name: Do not expedite
options.tradeoff: AX Hokuto service loss and modeled 3.24 mJPY foregone contribution

options.name: Expedite IC 540 units
options.merit: Up to 2.43 mJPY incremental modeled contribution net of fee
options.tradeoff: Unconfirmed delivery, quality, actual firm demand, and other capacity bottlenecks

reversal_conditions: Expedite delivery or QA cannot be confirmed
Fewer than 68 additional AX Hokuto units can be sold at assumed price/cost
Factory capacity or alternative material constraints invalidate the BOM-only case
FG inventory is not available as assumed
